verdict.rationale: Riveter's marketing site says projects can be scheduled to monitor for changes on a recurring basis, with refreshes as often as every minute. That is a genuine recurring schedule, not a one-off run or webhook-on-completion. However, the developer docs, SDK and MCP evidence never show how to create or manage schedules programmatically, so the AI-native depth is unproven. Missing for 10: API/SDK/MCP endpoints for creating and managing schedules, documented cadence options and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Schedule any project to monitor for changes and keep your data fresh.
For fast moving data like scores or election results, you can refresh as often as every minute.
